Package com.helix.profiler.node

Class NodeStats

java.lang.Object
com.helix.profiler.node.NodeStats
public class NodeStats extends Object
Thread-safe statistics tracker for an individual AST expression node.

Tracks total execution count, cumulative execution duration in nanoseconds, and failure/short-circuit count using high-throughput striped LongAdder counters to ensure zero lock contention in highly concurrent execution paths.

    • getCostToFailureRatio

      public double getCostToFailureRatio()
      Calculates the cost-to-failure ratio: C_i / F_i.

      Used by adaptive AST optimizers to sort boolean predicate chains such that nodes with the lowest ratio (cheapest to fail) are evaluated first.

      Returns:
      cost-to-failure ratio, or POSITIVE_INFINITY if failure rate is zero
